description: Get a bundled donor summary for a single politician: cycle totals (raised, spent, cash-on-hand, debts), donor count, top 10 individual donors, and top 10 PAC donors, all in one response. Answers "who funds <politician>" or "biggest donors to <politician>" style questions without paging the full donor list.

cycle.description: Election cycle as 4-digit year (e.g. "2024"). Defaults to most recent cycle. FEC cycles are even years (2022, 2024, 2026); an odd year matches no cycle and returns no donors, and a year outside 1980-2100 is replaced by the current cycle.

name: get_politician_donor_summary
title: Get Politician Donor Summary
